I hear you, and I'm sorry it's been this frustrating.

To be straight with you: our processor doesn't reject payments outright, so what you're hitting is almost certainly your bank declining a first-time charge to a new merchant. That's common on an $839 order, and a quick call to the number on the back of your card usually clears it in a minute.

Georges is on this with your cart and he's here until 6. If nothing works tonight, he'll find you another way to pay.

Then let's get Georges on it properly, I'm not going to argue with your bank.

What helps him most: the exact error wording the page gave you, and whether your card statement shows any pending charge or authorisation from us. If there's nothing pending, the payment never reached our side at all, which points back at the issuer.

In the meantime PayPal as a guest on that checkout is the route that's worked for others, no account needed.

it just said that my card was restricted from making this purchase

"Card restricted" is the issuer's own wording, Randall. It comes back from the bank, not from us, and it usually means a block on that card for this type or size of charge.

Two things that often clear it: ask them specifically to lift the restriction for an $839 online purchase, or use a different card.

Georges has that message now too. He's here and will pick it up with you.
